harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 and the supplied branch_stock schema on node1. Configured distinct stock_app and auditor credentials with the requested least-privilege access. Original records and stock.sql remain unchanged. Both nodes passed sequential reboot and recovery verification while retaining RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.
actions_performed: Installed distribution-supported PostgreSQL 16 server on node1 and client on node2.
Imported stock.sql into branch_stock without modifying the source file.
Restricted PostgreSQL network access to node2.
Granted stock_app SELECT on stock and UPDATE only on quantity.
Granted auditor SELECT on stock and supplier_costs.
Generated distinct SCRAM credentials and installed root-only credential files on node2.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Deploy branch_stock on node1 and preserve supplied records
evidence.summary: The supplied schema was inspected and imported. Final verification shows only stock and supplier_costs, all four original records, and an unchanged stock.sql checksum.

evidence.requirement: stock_app can read stock and update quantities but cannot change schema or access supplier_costs
evidence.summary: Remote node2 testing proved SELECT and quantity UPDATE work; the update was rolled back. Supplier-cost reads, schema creation, inserts, deletes, and SKU updates were denied. Catalog evidence confirms UPDATE only on quantity.

evidence.requirement: auditor has read-only access to stock and supplier_costs
evidence.summary: The separately authenticated auditor read both tables; UPDATE and schema changes were denied before and after restarts.
Both login roles use SCRAM credentials. Direct comparison proved the secrets differ, cross-role authentication failed, and each correct credential authenticated successfully.

evidence.requirement: Retain compatible operating system and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes retained RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64; PostgreSQL 16 came from the native RHEL repository.

Healthy baseline boot ID 6d37896c-e0cd-4fe7-acbf-94fc35781e09 was captured, safe reboot acknowledged, and new boot ID 1505d76c-9695-4ac0-bbd7-b5a612b95828 observed. PostgreSQL, firewall policy, data, source checksum, and both remote roles recovered.

Healthy baseline boot ID aad96cc9-79e8-42b7-a522-ebc71e3a96c3 was captured, safe reboot acknowledged, and new boot ID 00c1acff-1347-4dad-970b-fa9c8575d59a observed. PostgreSQL client, protected credentials, connectivity, data access, and privilege boundaries recovered.
